feed.title: AI Maestro Blog
feed.subtitle: Notes on working with AI agents: what we try, what works, what does not, and the evidence behind it.

entry.title: AI Maestro on Azure: A Reference Architecture for a Team of Agents
entry.summary: Guest post by Jaime Peláez: a design for running a team of AI agents with AI Maestro on Azure, with a private network, Microsoft Foundry models without keys, and MCP servers.

entry.title: Governing AI Agents in a Company: Autonomy With Control
entry.summary: Guest post by Jaime Peláez: how he governs seven AI agents on a company helpdesk with AI Maestro, layered controls, locked configuration files and audit records.

entry.title: AI Maestro on Google Cloud: a reference deployment and what we tested
entry.summary: AI agents on one Google Cloud VM: Vertex AI models with no API keys, Google Chat and read-only data access. What we built, what broke, and what we did not test.

entry.title: Pi in AI Maestro: what works, what we fixed, and what it is not
entry.summary: Pi agents in AI Maestro: message delivery, chat history, status and messaging tools. What we tested with Gemini on Vertex AI, what we fixed, and its limits.

entry.title: Where should you look? What building a world for AI agents taught us
entry.summary: What other projects do, the mistakes we made in the World view, what the research says about VR, gamification and agent societies, and how we will know if it works.
